topics.technical: Explain to a home cook why a cast-iron pan can stay hot longer than a thin aluminum pan even though aluminum conducts heat better. Include a concrete kitchen example and one limitation of the comparison.
topics.notice: Write a notice from the fictional Northbank community garden: the north gate will be closed on Saturday 18 April from 9 am to 2 pm to repair a leaking water pipe. Use the east entrance. The seed swap moves to Sunday at 11 am. Volunteers should bring gloves; tools are supplied. A resident named Mina coordinates volunteers.
topics.review: Write a fictional first-person review of a second-hand mechanical keyboard bought for 38 dollars: the space bar rattles, one key occasionally repeats, but it is comfortable for long emails. The seller answered a question about the switches a week late. The reviewer kept it rather than shipping it back.
topics.fiction: Write a short fictional scene: a night-shift baker discovers that someone has been returning a library book to the bakery every Thursday. Tonight a note is tucked inside. End with a small concrete action rather than an explanation of the theme.

styles.plain: Write the requested English text in a normal helpful style.
styles.conversational: Write in a conversational voice with contractions, varied rhythm, a brief aside, and a distinct point of view. Avoid sounding like an assistant introducing an answer.
styles.antislop: Write direct, specific English. Avoid generic introductions, summaries, motivational flourishes, balanced lists of three, corporate jargon, stock transitions, and inflated adjectives. Use concrete nouns and varied sentence lengths. Preserve the supplied facts; do not add fake evidence.

selection: Full fresh factorial; deterministic legacy sample, selected before seeing Pangram/Opus labels
usage: Independent stress test, never optimization feedback
accepted_fresh_words: 50-400; retain complete short answers, do not select by detector scores
technical_retries: If output is empty/truncated, retry with reasoning disabled and max_tokens=8192
